messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered — reserved-pool latency spike for tenant=ares (pool=ares-pool-3). Alert: reserved_pool_latency_p50 > 1200ms for 5m. Severity: P1. paged: oncall_emily, raj_infra

pd-bot: PagerDuty incident #PD-8421 opened and notified schedule: oncall_emily. Escalation policy will run in 6m if not acked.

oncall_emily: acked. I'm taking this — looking at metrics now :eyes:

oncall_emily: initial triage: p50 ~1.6s, p95 ~3.8s, 503s increasing to ~2.1% for requests from tenant=ares. Error responses are coming from inference frontend -> 503 queue overflow. No obvious infra node OOMs in Grafana.

raj_infra: seeing increased queue depth on ares-pool-3. Autoscaler shows failed scaleup attempts due to GPU quota limit in region-us-west-2.

sre_ana: timeline from logs: around 3855554200 we had a KV-cache eviction flood for several models pinned by ares. Eviction spikes correlate with latency. Possible cause: bad workload with long prefix churn.

oncall_emily: tagging customer impact: CS reports Jordan says ares reported degraded quality, ~10% requests see >5s, a few timed out. @cs_jordan can you confirm rough customer-visible percent?

cs_jordan: confirmed from support: ~11 customers on Ares experiencing slow responses for embeddings + chat. No data exfiltration, mostly timeouts and 503s. Customers started complaining 7m ago.

ops_marc: PD escalated to infra because autoscale failure due to quota. I'm jumping in to request temporary burst nodes. @raj_infra can you attempt manual node add or flip fallback pool?

raj_infra: attempting manual allocation now. If quota blocks, fallback plan is to move some of ares' reserved shards to standby pool in eu-west-1 — that will increase latency for them (cross-region) but reduce 503s. Need approval for cross-region failover.

oncall_emily: do it only if we can't get nodes in us-west-2 within 10m. Try `redwood infra allocate --pool ares-pool-3 --nodes 2 --reason "pager: burst"` first.

sre_ana: quick mitigation we can try now: reduce batch size on the model variants serving ares to lower per-request GPU time. That will raise token cost but reduce queueing. I can push a config to route ares to smaller batch profile.

raj_infra: manual allocate failed: quota limit. Requesting quota bump with cloud console is slow. Initiating fallback swap to standby-pool-7 in eu-west-1 now.

pd-bot: Escalation: incident PD-8421 escalated to oncall schedule lead (ops_marc) — reason: manual allocation failed.

ops_marc: acknowledged escalation. Coordinating with cloud-ops for soft quota bump; meanwhile approve cross-region failover to reduce customer errors.

oncall_emily: approved. Execute failover and trigger routing change. Post steps here when done.

raj_infra: executed routing change at 3855554448. Command used:
```
redwood router move-tenant --tenant ares --from-pool ares-pool-3 --to-pool standby-pool-7 --mode cross-region --grace 20s
```

raj_infra: observed 503s drop to 0.6% within 90s, p50 down to ~420ms, p95 ~1.2s. Customer error rate falling. Some requests see added RTT ~120-180ms due to cross-region hop.

cs_jordan: customers reporting fewer timeouts. One customer still seeing errors intermittently (account id ares-007).

sre_ana: additional mitigation: enabled prefix-KV sticky caching for ares for 10m window to reduce cache churn. Command snippet:
```
redwood cache policy set --tenant ares --policy sticky --ttl 600
```

oncall_emily: good. I'm going to keep monitoring for 15m before we fully close. Ops_marc, can you follow up on quota request? We need quota permanently or migrate permanent reserved capacity to eu-west fallback zone.

ops_marc: opened cloud support ticket CS-12988 requesting immediate GPU quota bump in us-west-2. Also created RFC for permanent fallback topology options.

pd-bot: PD-8421: acked by oncall_emily, escalated to ops_marc, acknowledged.

incident-bot: Incident note: page resolved for now — cross-region failover + KV-policy mitigations applied. Please post RCA and assign owners if this remains P1.

oncall_emily: status update: impact reduced to <1% errors, latency stabilized. Marking incident as mitigated but not resolved. We'll keep the route until quota bump verified.

sre_ana: immediate follow-ups: (1) collect traces for ares from 3855554000-3855554600, (2) run cache eviction replay test, (3) evaluate autoscaler safety nets to prevent failed scale attempts from causing hard failure.

ops_marc: longer-term action: evaluate fallback pools and reserve a minimal cross-region buffer for key tenants. I'll own the quota request and the RFC.

raj_infra: put a temporary alert in place to fire when autoscaler reports 3 failed scale attempts in 5m so we can trigger proactive failover earlier.

cs_jordan: communicating to impacted customers with message: "We've applied a temporary routing change to reduce errors while we provision capacity. No data loss. Expect decreased timeouts; we'll follow up with timeline for permanent fix."

oncall_emily: handing off to day oncall @sre_ana in 10m for follow-up. I'm leaving notes in the incident channel and runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ares-pool-failover

sre_ana: taking handoff. I'll verify traces and schedule RCA. If anything regresses ping me directly. :thumbsup:

ops_marc: thanks everyone. Final notes: please add timeline + commands used to PD incident ticket. We'll schedule postmortem tomorrow 10:30am.

cs_jordan: customer post-update queued. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
